title.rendered: He Goes Before You: Morning Devotional

excerpt.rendered: God does not send you ahead while He follows from a distance, He goes before you. Today’s Friday devotional on Deuteronomy 31:8 and what it means that He has already been where you are going.

content.rendered:
The Gospel For Today | Friday, May 1, 2026

📖 Today’s Scripture

“The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged.”
Deuteronomy 31:8 (NIV) | ESV

📝 Today’s Message

Moses spoke these words to Joshua on the edge of the Promised Land, a land Joshua had never entered, full of enemies he had not yet faced. The weight of what lay ahead was enormous. And God’s answer to that weight was not a battle plan. It was a presence.

The Lord himself goes before you. Not a strategy. Not a guarantee that the road will be easy. God Himself, going ahead. Preparing the way. Already in the territory you have not yet stepped into. When you arrive at the challenge that feels impossible, He has already been there. You are not walking into the unknown. You are walking into where God already is.

And He will never leave you nor forsake you. The writer of Hebrews quotes this exact promise in Hebrews 13:5–6 and draws out its full implication: “So we say with confidence: ‘The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid.'” The never-leaving, never-forsaking God is your helper. That changes the mathematics of every situation you face.

Romans 8:31 asks the question this promise answers: “If God is for us, who can be against us?” Whatever you are walking into today, He has already gone before you. Do not be afraid. Do not be discouraged. He is already there.

🙏 Prayer

Father, thank You that You go before me into every situation I face today. I am not walking into the unknown, I am walking into where You already are. I release fear and discouragement and I receive confidence in Your presence. You will never leave me. You will never forsake me. Lead me, Lord, I follow You. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

🗣️ Declaration

The Lord goes before me today. He has already been into the situation I am facing and He is already working. I am not alone and I am not without help. God is for me, and if God is for me, no opposition can ultimately prevail. I refuse fear and discouragement. I walk forward in confidence because the God who never leaves me, never forsakes me, and always goes ahead of me is with me right now.
